source_basis: src/lib/scrape/capture-with-fallback.ts classifies about: as unreachable-url before content-script messaging or injection.
src/features/seo/SeoView.tsx clears the prior audit and renders the browser-internal or restricted URL error for unreachable-url.
limits: No browser, tests, or build were launched in preparation; new subtargets have no runtime pass yet.
This covers one restricted browser scheme and positive recovery. Unreachable HTTP(S), other restricted schemes, failure after manual retry, and reload remain unverified.
The exact visible error and disappearance of stale details are required; a navigation or audit failure leaves the batch unverified rather than passing a fallback.
The batch does not read or write the clipboard or test member/admin access.
